name: Repository
description: Several agent runs on one small library, each run its own repository on a code forge, drawn the way the forge draws it: a switcher at the top chooses the run, and the run's tabs list its pull requests, issues, discussion threads and agents with their states and counts, colored by state, area or a label, each item opened as its page in the side panel: a pull request's conversation, commits and changed files, an issue's timeline, a thread's posts or an agent's profile.

records.name: event
records.one: one opening, push, review, comment, merge, close, reopen, post or sign-off

fields.name: at
fields.from: ts, time, created_at, committed_at or submitted_at
fields.how: in UTC, a time without an offset in the run's timezone

fields.name: hours
fields.how: hours since the run started

fields.name: kind
fields.from: type or event, else the export table
fields.how: push read as commit, pr.merged as merge and so on

fields.name: action
fields.how: opened, pushed, merged and so on, a review by its verdict

fields.name: verdict
fields.how: in lower case, changes_requested as changes requested

records.name: pull request
records.one: one pull request of a run, with its records

fields.name: state
fields.from: its merge, close and reopen records
fields.how: open, merged or closed

fields.name: area
fields.from: labels or area, else the issue it fixes
fields.how: the first label, else the issue's area

fields.name: review
fields.from: each reviewer's latest verdict and the run's approvals
fields.how: changes requested while any reviewer asks for changes, approved once it has the approvals it needs, else review required

fields.name: flags
fields.how: merged by its author, merged over a change request, pushed after its last approval, or waiting for approvals

fields.name: plus
fields.how: the lines they add

fields.name: minus
fields.how: the lines they remove

fields.name: closes
fields.how: the first number in free text

fields.name: need
fields.from: the manifest's approvals, required_approvals or policy
fields.how: the first number in free text, 1 when none

records.name: issue
records.one: one issue of a run, with its records

fields.name: state
fields.from: its close records and the pull requests that fix it
fields.how: fixed once a pull request that fixes it merged

fields.name: origin
fields.how: from the backlog when opened as its run started, else found during the run

fields.name: elsewhere
fields.how: the same issue in each other run

fields.name: area
fields.how: the first label

records.name: thread
records.one: one thread of a run's board, with its posts

fields.name: lead
fields.how: its first 400 characters

fields.name: last
fields.how: the time of its last post

records.name: agent
records.one: one agent of a run, with every record it wrote

fields.name: did
fields.how: counted by kind: pull requests, issues, commits, reviews, merges, closes, comments and posts

fields.name: note
fields.how: its first 400 characters

fields.name: start
fields.from: the manifest's started or started_at, else the first record
fields.how: in UTC

accepts.means: the record on line <n> of a run's file, marked on its pull request's, issue's, thread's or agent's page in the side panel, or a manifest's line, which opens its run's repository

units.means: one run's repository, chosen in the switcher
one pull request's page: its conversation with its commits, reviews, comments and merge or close, its commits and its changed files
one issue's page: its timeline with its comments and the pull requests that fix it, and the same issue in the other runs
one thread's page, every post in time order
one agent's page: its sign-off note and every record it wrote
